question: How fast should enemy bullets fly? Every enemy shot now has a tell: a dashed vermilion aim line for 0.35 s (it tracks Rivet for the first half, then locks and thickens), then a muzzle flash and a 3-round volley at the locked point. In both 20 s clips Rivet sidesteps 250 ms after each tell starts (a human read) while three gunners take turns. Speed mostly changes how readable a round is, not how often it hits: the tell is the difficulty dial.

options.label: 0.45x the player's round (pistol 27 m/s): every round visibly crosses the screen
options.tradeoff: most readable; slow rounds linger, so you can step into another gunner's round (6 of 91 hit)

options.label: 0.65x (pistol 39 m/s): snappier, still visible at 32 px/m
options.tradeoff: punchier, shorter on screen; 3 of 91 hit because the dodge comes from the lock
